products.name: Microsoft Teams Apps & Integration Governance — Commercial
products.short_description: Govern Teams apps & integrations — app permission/setup policies, allow/block + pinning, custom/LOB + third-party management, consent/permission review, and a vetting workflow — so only trusted apps run in Teams. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Govern which apps and bots run inside Microsoft Teams

Every app added to Teams gains access to collaboration data — ungoverned, it's an unmanaged supply chain. This solution governs Teams apps and integrations: app permission and setup policies, org-wide allow/block and pinning, custom/line-of-business and third-party app management, admin consent and Graph-permission review, and an app-vetting workflow — so only trusted, useful apps are available.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the app-governance model: app permission + setup policies, allow/block + pinning, custom/LOB vs third-party, consent/permission review, and vetting.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (Teams admin roles, app catalog, security/governance stakeholders, risk criteria).
  • Implementation Guide — set app permission + setup policies, configure allow/block + pinning, manage custom/LOB uploads, review consent/Graph permissions, and wire an app-vetting workflow — pilot-first, each policy named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic MicrosoftTeams PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (only vetted apps available, risky permissions reviewed) plus Best Practices for ongoing app governance.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Only trusted, useful apps in Teams — permission and setup policies set, risky apps blocked, consent reviewed, new apps vetted — the collaboration supply chain governed.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • TEAMSAPPS-Configure.ps1 — SAFELY create/update Teams app permission + setup policies from a definition. Defaults to -WhatIf
    • TEAMSAPPS-ConsentReport.ps1 — read-only consent/Graph-permission review for Teams apps; risk-flags high-impact permissions
    • TEAMSAPPS-Discovery.ps1 — read-only inventory of Teams app permission/setup policies, the app catalog (by distribution method), and installed apps
    • TEAMSAPPS-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — assign (or reset to Global) the Teams app permission + setup policies for a pilot group. Defaults to -WhatIf
    • TEAMSAPPS-Validation.ps1 — read-only check that a user population is assigned the intended app permission + setup policies

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
